name: How do I choose which renovations to do before listing my house?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose which renovations to do before listing my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritize renovations that address critical repairs, enhance curb appeal, and update key living spaces like kitchens and bathrooms. Consider the typical buyer profile for your neighborhood and their expectations. A good approach is to consult with a real estate professional like Kelby Contreras; they can provide insights into what upgrades are most valued by buyers in specific South Florida communities, ensuring your efforts are well-placed. This guidance helps avoid over-improving for your market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose renovations that address critical repairs, enhance curb appeal, and update key areas. Consult with a real estate professional to align updates with local buyer expectations and avoid over-improving your home.
